_comment: Side-view bottom types, cropped from the Bottom Types chart.
POOL.LSP draws SIX of the twelve. pool:*btypes* is the authority:
The other six are shown greyed so the chart on screen matches the
chart on paper and the gap is visible rather than silently missing.
Keys are the sheet letters lower-cased. The plan chain (H G F E, or
E2 F2 G F1 E1 on a Sport) is keyed through pool:askseqb. The depths
C, D and C2 are NOT -- they go through pool:askh / pool:askdeep /
pool:askc2 and are keyed off the prompt's letter prefix instead.
B is shown on every section but is never an input here: the overall
length is already settled by the plan view before a bottom is asked
C1, C3, C4 and F3 appear only on bottoms POOL cannot draw, so they
are collected nowhere and are inactive everywhere.
x/y are FRACTIONS of the image. Seeded estimates, meant to be nudged.

standard-hopper._note: Normal is the only style that draws no side profile, so it never asks C or D

dimensions.label: H - left end to deep end
E - slope break to right end
C2 - depth where the shallow floor meets the break

wedge._note: G and E are pinned by the style; only H and F are asked
